errorCodes.meaning: No badge the caller owns or administers has this identifier. Conflates an unknown badge, one the caller may not see, badges being off, and a badge the caller may see but does not own.
`cursor` was not issued for this caller and badge.

BadgeId.description: Opaque identifier of a badge: `bdg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BDG-001).
BadgeId.title: BadgeId

ClaimCode.description: A claim code's record, as the badge's owners and administrators see it: never the code (VTI-BDG-027).

claims.description: How many members have redeemed it.

createdBy.description: The issuer's entry, where they have one; the giver of every award the code admits.

label.description: What the code is for — the event, say — shown to the badge's owners. Never shown to whoever redeems it.

limit.description: How many claims the code admits.

state.description: `withdrawn` once its issuer withdrew it or the badge was retired. A code past `validUntil` or out of claims stays `active` and admits no one.

validUntil.description: After this the code admits no one.

ClaimCode.title: ClaimCode

ClaimId.description: Opaque identifier of a claim code's record: `bcl_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random; never the code itself, which the community keeps only as a digest (VTI-BDG-025).
ClaimId.title: ClaimId

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/claims/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/claims/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

schema.description: A badge's claim codes, as its owners and administrators see them: never a code. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the badge; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.
